fusions.name: Unhurried Blow
fusions.desc: A slow, heavy blow that deals 20 damage and stuns the target for 1.6 seconds, leaving it 14% easier to wound for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Slow Reckoning
fusions.desc: Hits every enemy within 3.5 tiles, dealing 7 damage to each, with a 40% chance each of [Stalled] for 6 seconds, its abilities coming back slower. It costs 5% of your maximum health.

fusions.name: Settled Weight
fusions.desc: Reduces the damage you take by 20% for 12 seconds.

fusions.name: Arrives Eventually
fusions.desc: After 8 seconds without a critical hit, your crit chance rises by 40% for your next strike. Once every 8 seconds.
